name: Sorcerer Rage Mage
body:
A rage mage is a sorcerer with in-born magic, but also an inborn rage. They are not as adept at spellcasting as other spellcasters but their rage empowers their spells.

Diminished Spellcasting: A rage mage uses the spellcasting progression of a summoner. This ability modifies spellcasting.

Spell Rage (Su)

Beginning with 1st level, a rage mage lets the rage boiling in their blood to burst forth. They can spell rage for a number of rounds per day equal to 4 + their Charisma modifier. At each level after 1st, they can spell rage for an additional 2 rounds per day.

Temporary increases to Charisma, such as that gained from eagle’s splendor, do not increase the total number of rounds that a rage mage can spell rage per day. A rage mage can enter a spell rage as a free action. The total number of rounds of spell rage per day is renewed after regaining spells.

When in a spell rage, a rage mage gains a +2 bonus to the DCs and attack rolls of their spells for any evocation, conjuration, necromancy, or transmutation spell. Additionally, they gain a +2 bonus to caster level for dispel attempts and to bypass spell resistance as well.

However, while in the spell rage, the roiling magic energy makes them more susceptible to the spells of others, they take a -2 penalty to AC and saves against spells and spell-like abilities and they take a -2 penalty to concentration checks. The penalty to saving throws does not extend to enchantment, compulsion, charm, or fear effects. While in the spell rage, a rage mage cannot use any Charisma– or Intelligence-based skill, except for Intimidate.

A rage mage can end their spell rage as a free action and is fatigued for 1 minute after the spell rage ends. A rage mage cannot enter a new spell rage while fatigued or exhausted, but otherwise can enter a spell rage multiple times per day. If the rage mage falls unconscious, their spell rage immediately ends.

Spell Rage Power (Su)

At 6th level, a rage mage adds 1/2 their sorcerer class level to damage dealt with spells while in their spell rage. This bonus only applies once to a spell, not once per missile or ray, and cannot be split between multiple missiles or rays. This bonus damage is not increased by Empower Spell or similar effects.

Greater Spell Rage (Su)

At 11th level, a rage mage increases the bonus to DCs, attack rolls and caster level checks to +3 while in their spell rage.

Tireless Spell Rage (Su)

At 17th level, a rage mage is no longer fatigued at the end of their spell rage.

Mighty Spell Rage (Su)

At 20th level, a rage mage increases the bonus to DCs, attack rolls and caster level checks to +4 while in their spell rage.
